description: This file defines a class 'Language' that extends 'ListableDisplayField' within the OrangeHRM reporting system. It specifies methods for obtaining the associated DTO class, entity aliases, and report fields related to language information in the HRM context.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a language display field in HRM reports, configuring DTO class, entity aliases, and report fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides an array of entity aliases used in database queries for report generation.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Specifies the database fields relevant to this display field, specifically the employee number.
